confirmation.source: User request on 2026-10-31: swarm pathfinding fix and Dart Gun card
confirmation.implementationDefaults: Unspecified values chosen for implementation: 420 HP, 1.5 tiles/s, projectile speed22, model scale1.05, collision radius0.42; ground troop targets ground/air troops and structures.

mechanicNotes: New card: Dart Gun, a fictional 81-year-old African American WWII veteran. Costs3 Aether;420HP;50damage every0.4seconds (125basicDPS);8.5-tile attack range;1.5tiles/s movement;22tiles/s darts;ground/air troops and structures.
Dart Gun uses a detailed veteran model, slow walking animation, rapid firing recoil, visible dart projectiles, model-rendered portrait and deployment audio.
Friendly swarm routing allows blocked troops to make progress while retaining physical separation, enemy blocking and planted melee attacks.

Ranged troops can acquire enemies in front up to their attack range when it exceeds8tiles. Dart Gun notices enemies8.5tiles ahead; rear detection remains5tiles. Existing cards retain their detection ranges.
Existing card stats, abilities, arena geometry and art remain unchanged. Navigation revision12 separates new simulation results from earlier movement rules.
